relationships.subject: esketamine plus 5-fluorouracil
relationships.evidence_quote: MMP-9, a molecule critically involved in cell migration, was downregulated in DLD1 and HCT15 cells following combination treatment

relationships.subject: esketamine plus 5-fluorouracil
relationships.evidence_quote: the combination treatment enhanced AMPK phosphorylation and suppressed the levels of phosphorylated mTOR and HMMR in both DLD1 and HCT15 cells

relationships.subject: AMPK
relationships.evidence_quote: In mammalian systems, AMPK can negatively regulate mTOR, thereby inducing apoptosis and autophagy in colon cancer both in vitro and in vivo

key_findings: Esketamine synergizes with 5-FU to suppress proliferation, migration and invasion and induce apoptosis in DLD1 and HCT15 colorectal cells
Combination increases AMPK phosphorylation and reduces p-mTOR and HMMR; HMMR overexpression attenuates the effect
